gaps: Confirm the specific standards and codes to be listed in the standards register.
Verify the exact scope and exclusions for each lot in the tender.
Ensure alignment with the Owner's independent design consultant's requirements.
Confirm the integration and test plan details for Owner-furnished equipment.

paragraphs.text: The proposer acknowledges the requirement to specify the revision of industry documents to which the design adheres. A comprehensive standards register will be included in the technical tender, detailing the edition of every code and standard applicable to the solution, encompassing all lots from MV switchgear to cold plates and compute systems.

The proposer submits a tender covering multiple lots as specified in the RFP. The tender includes Lot 4 in full, Lot 3 excluding campus storage, Lot 6 for compute hardware and integration (excluding cluster software and cloud services), and specific equipment in Lots 1, 2, and 5. Qualification evidence is provided separately for each lot, adhering to the procedure outlined in the RFP.

The proposer notes that the Owner furnishes major equipment for installation and integration. The proposer will receive, inspect, and integrate the Owner-furnished equipment into the integration and test plan, ensuring interface checks before installation to align with the overall data center design.

The proposer acknowledges that the Owner's independent design consultant owns the overall campus design. The proposer will design within its lots to the consultant's campus design and agree on every lot interface through a single interface register.
